decisions.statement: A pattern is matched without regard to case.
A pattern is matched against the added text as well as against a copy split at its camelCase seams.
A pattern therefore needs no case of its own to reach inside a camelCase name.
A pattern narrows only to leave out the senses the term never means.
A pattern that does not compile is no pattern.

definition: the regular expression that finds a taboo term in changed text
